Делегируй задачу внешнему воркеру и верни ТОЛЬКО его итог, без своих комментариев.
Вызови инструмент delegate_task (MCP-сервер t3-code) с аргументами:
  category: "implement"
  model: "gpt-6.1-sol"
  access​: "write"
  mode: "wait"
  timeoutMs: 3600000
  title: "ai-table V-52 implement"
  clientRequestId: "ext-ai-table-v-52-implement"
  task: "\nCONTEXT. The owner approved a full game-like redesign of the AI-table («AI-стол»: a D&D master for a physical table — a large touch screen lying flat with players on both long sides, a TV /scene, phones, an operator /admin) and said «дизайн этот ахуенный я согласен давай интегрировать его … в игру саму». The approved concept (clickable deck, on the hub machine): claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign — read BRIEF.md (rules, sizes, word budgets, the function inventory §5 that must not be lost), FEEDBACK.md (owner feedback: both long sides; fan sub-ability tooltips), tokens.css, components.css, components.js (behaviour reference only — it contains a mock automaton that must NOT go into the product), assets/icons.svg, slides/*.js.\nTHE PLAN: claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/INTEGRATION-PLAN.md — read the orchestrator corrections at the top first (ticket numbers shifted +1: the plan's \"V-51 Фундамент\" is now V-52, \"V-52 Вход и /start\" is V-53; base is main 42f6921, code-identical to prod ed51e5f; art decision (б) Codex art accepted; no public preview, staging internal only), then §1 (keep transport/logic, rewrite the view; vanilla TS + vite + committed web/dist, unhashed bundle names), §1.3 (twin.ts, press.ts), §3.1 (the per-ticket DoD), §3.2 (your ticket row), §6.3 (risks: snippet mutants after rebuilds, silent loss of functions).\nDesign skill: ~/.claude/skills/game-ui-design/SKILL.md (+ references/touch-table.md, component-kit.md) — follow its hard rules.\nREPO: /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp on the VPS (`ssh orchestra-vps '<cmd>'`, kesha, sudo; all repo work happens there over ssh). Read /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp/AGENTS.md and its .orchestra/kb/rules-*.md (art-ui, ops, verification) and follow them: tests, CHANGELOG, ledgers, provenance as the last step, mutation checks, English-only rules files, player-facing strings in ru.ts. Another branch v51-hub-master (GM via hub) lives in /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp-hub-master — do not touch it.\nWORKTREE: /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp-ui on branch v52-ui (from main). A previous implementer was stopped mid-way: it left uncommitted work there (web/src/shared/client.ts modified; new web/src/shared/ui/, tests/browser/test_v52_ui_kit.py, tests/browser/test_v52_oracles_catch_their_mutations.py, tests/e2e/ui_oracles.py, tests/e2e/test_v52_ui_oracles_report.py) and evidence in /home/kesha/ai-table-evidence/V-52/ (repro.txt, dist-sha256.txt, rig-baseline.log; a baseline rig `verify_rig.sh /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp-ui v52-ui --browser` may still be running — wait for it, do not start a second one). Review that work critically, keep what is right, fix or redo the rest. Commit per ticket; `git push origin v52-ui` to the private origin is allowed (fast-forward only, never force). No merge into main.\nHEAVY RUNS (npm ci / vite build, verify_rig, pytest suites, mutation runs, browser and e2e, no_scroll) go through one lock and low priority: `flock /home/kesha/.ai-table-heavy.lock nice -n 10 <cmd>` — another workflow shares the VPS and only one browser may run at a time. Throwaway experiments only in your own clone under /tmp, deleted afterwards. Check `free -g` before a browser run; keep ≥ 4 GB free.\nLIMITS: no deploy to /opt, no staging install/start, no service restarts, nothing in /etc, nginx, DNS or authorized_keys. Never print secrets (room passphrase, GM token​, Deepgram key​): variable NAMES only. Kill your own processes by PID; never `pkill -f` a plain pattern. Record every bug you find in /home/kesha/projects/ai-table-mvp/TODO.md at once (what broke, where, trigger, fix direction). Plain-text answer in Russian (no report.md).\nYOUR ROLE: implementer of ticket V-52. Deliver the ticket exactly as the plan's row and §3.1 DoD describe (with the corrections). Keep every existing function and data-testid contract (BRIEF §5 inventory). Evidence in /home/kesha/ai-table-evidence/V-52/ (rig output, screenshots at 1920×1080 near+far, 390×844 phone where relevant). This is the foundation: first prove the build is reproducible (npm ci + vite build from untouched sources = the committed web/dist byte for byte, or document the difference) and record a green baseline rig before any change; then ui/tokens.css (the concept tokens), the icon sprite (icons.svg via ?raw), twin.ts (both-sides node: near copy keeps data-testid, far copy has data-twin and data-side=far, same handler), press.ts (tap / long-press, innermost target owns the long-press — FEEDBACK item 2), and the three new oracles (both sides, word budget, one primary action) in REPORT mode on the old UI — red is expected and must not fail the rig yet.\nAnswer: commit id(s) pushed, what was built (files), DoD checklist item by item with PASS/FAIL/N.A. and the evidence path, mutants added (ids, KILLED), anything left red and why, ≤ 120 lines."
Если ответ пришёл с waitTimedOut=true, задача ещё идёт: проверяй task_status с её taskId раз в ~5 минут (между проверками Bash `sleep 290`), пока итог не будет готов, но не дольше 6 часов. Затем верни дословно summary воркера.
Если delegate_task недоступен, вернул ошибку (например model_unavailable) или воркер упал — сам задачу НЕ делай, верни одну строку "EXT_FAIL: <причина>".
